description: This file defines the class FieldInfo, which represents a field in Java bytecode, including its name, type, and normalized type. It provides methods for constructing a field info object, retrieving a combined name and type, and normalizing types using utility functions.

classes.name: FieldInfo
classes.description: Container representing a field (or method, as per comment) with parameters, storing name, type, and combined descriptors. Provides methods for retrieving type descriptors and normalizing type names.

methods.name: FieldInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the field's name and type.

methods.name: getNameAndType
methods.description: Returns a combined string of the name and type, used as a hash key, with type converted to descriptor format.

methods.name: normalizeType
methods.description: Normalizes the field's type name using utility functions, updating the internal type and descriptor cache if needed.
